2. The contemporaneous price report in [5] gives 19,230 VND/litre for E5 RON 92 and 19,630 VND/litre for RON95-III. It does not identify RON 92-III as costing 19,630 VND.
3. The retrieved citations therefore do not substantiate the gold target’s specific claim about the price of RON 92-III. The exact figure appears only as an unsupported expected-answer field, while the relevant pricing report assigns that figure to a different grade.
